title: ¿Qué es el populismo?
goal: Read how Latin American populism is typically defined, its common features, and the ongoing scholarly debate over whether it's a style, an ideology, or a strategy.
grammar: Se suele + infinitivo: describir un patrón general

items: State how Latin American populism is usually defined.
Name the typical characteristics scholars point to in these movements.
Explain the scholarly disagreement over how to classify populism.
Describe the context these movements emerged from.
Use se suele + infinitive to describe a general pattern impersonally.
